summary: Aptera Motors filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing updated capital requirements and production timing tied to its previously announced partnership with Shanghai Launch Automotive Technology (Launch Design). Start-of-production funding needs fell to roughly $25 million from $40–45 million; reaching 500 vehicles per month requires about $65 million total, and scaling toward roughly 20,000 vehicles annually requires about $115 million versus the prior $180–205 million estimate. First 40 production vehicles are targeted by end-2026, with initial deliveries in early 2027. No securities transaction, offer, or deal terms are disclosed; this is ordinary operational guidance, not a special situation.
